_comment: What IS the website. Only files matching `include` (and not `exclude`) are ever uploaded by scripts/deploy.py. Paths are relative to the repo root and map 1:1 onto mcgheelab.com/. Add a new top-level file or folder here when the site starts needing it. Root vendor/ is NOT the site: it is the Heroicons source for scripts/gen-icons.mjs (rm/vendor/ IS served).

ftp._tlsHost: V3.925: GoDaddy's FTP certificate is *.prod.phx3.secureserver.net, never mcgheelab.com, so TLS verifies only by the server's own name (cPanel → Server Information → Server Name; also the mail banner on port 587). deploy.py connects by it after checking it is still the machine `host` points at. `host` stays the site's name: the macOS Keychain entry is filed under it. tls 'always': a TLS failure stops the deploy; until V3.925 'auto' fell back to plain FTP on every deploy, password included.

_autoDeploy: V3.818: the Claude Code Stop hook runs `deploy.py autodeploy` at the end of every turn. Set false (or MCGHEELAB_AUTODEPLOY=0) to pause, e.g. during a live lecture.
_autoPushSkip: Files the hook leaves for a hand push. GitHub refuses a push that adds or changes a workflow file unless the token has the `workflow` scope (the Keychain credential does not): `gh auth refresh -h github.com -s workflow && gh auth setup-git`, then push .github/workflows yourself and empty this list.
_autoPush: V3.868: before autodeploy, the Stop hook runs `scripts/git_autopush.py`: commit the turn, rebase onto origin/main, push through the merge checker. A batch above autoPushMaxFiles waits for `--batch`; autoPushAllow lists paths the secret/confidential guard may commit anyway; deployBranch is the only branch deploy.py ships from. Set autoPush false (or MCGHEELAB_AUTOPUSH=0) to pause.
